name: cli-design
description: Trigger: building or reviewing a command-line tool, designing command trees, flags, or I/O contracts, implementing an output layer, or testing CLI behaviour. Language-agnostic Unix-composability rules: stdout carries data only, stderr carries everything else, semantic exit codes, --json/--plain format contracts, TTY detection, prompt bypass, config precedence, and stable output.
abstract: Adapted from citypaul's cli-design skill (itself a CC BY-SA 4.0 adaptation of the Command Line Interface Guidelines): stream separation, pure handlers, three-tier format contracts with versioned JSON envelopes, semantic exit codes, TTY and colour detection, prompt bypass and secret handling, config precedence, composable pipe patterns, and the additive stdout stability contract.
